STORY — 30 SECONDS:

0–5 seconds: Establish a crowded underground station. A female railway engineer in a navy-blue uniform checks an electrical cabinet while passengers wait for their train.

5–10 seconds: Suddenly, the power fails. Red emergency lights activate, alarms sound, and an automated safety barrier locks. A father realizes his young daughter in a yellow raincoat is stranded on the opposite side.

10–15 seconds: The engineer notices an approaching train and realizes the safety system has malfunctioned. She immediately rushes toward an emergency control cabinet while a station attendant directs passengers away.

15–20 seconds: She opens the cabinet and struggles to pull an old emergency lever. The approaching train grows louder, creating intense suspense.

20–25 seconds: The emergency mechanism finally activates, and the barrier begins opening. The father reaches his daughter and pulls her safely away from the platform edge.

25–30 seconds: The train passes safely. The father embraces his daughter, the station lights return, and the little girl gives the exhausted engineer a grateful smile. End with a cinematic close-up of the engineer's relieved expression.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
Photorealistic characters, consistent faces and clothing, realistic human movement, believable physical interactions, dramatic lighting, wet-floor reflections and detailed railway environments.

CAMERA & AUDIO:
One continuous cinematic tracking shot with no cuts. Natural camera movement, realistic train sounds, rainfall, emergency alarms, mechanical sounds, footsteps and synchronized dialogue.

IMPORTANT:
Maintain character consistency and logical action continuity throughout. Avoid morphing, duplicated characters, unnatural movements and abrupt transitions. The final result should feel like an original professionally directed short film with suspense, emotional depth and a satisfying conclusion.

模特穿过酒店大堂中央，自信地朝镜头走来，被自然地定格在迈步之中。他的躯干朝向正前方，肩膀与胯部因行走动作而形成轻微的旋转。他的体态挺拔而放松，肩膀方正但不僵硬，胸部自然打开，头部保持平正。他的视线笔直投向镜头，神情严肃而沉着，传递出自信以及对周遭环境的完全熟悉。

他的左手随意搭在西装长裤的前口袋里，手肘在西装外套下方略微向外打开。这一姿态使西装外套左侧微微敞开，并在腰部与胯部形成自然的斜向褶皱。他的右臂自然垂于体侧，随行走动作略微向前摆动。手指自然分开、轻轻弯曲，手部解剖结构写实，没有夸张的手势。

一条腿向前迈出，另一条腿支撑体重，形成真实的行走步态。前方的鞋刚刚抬离或接近大理石地面，支撑脚则稳固踩实。他的裤子在膝部、大腿与脚踝处形成自然褶皱，面料随动作而起伏。他的外套在胯部周围略有位移，在保持剪裁轮廓结构的同时呈现出可信的动态。

龙虾怪站在木桌对面，机械绅士在它后侧，法老和怪嘴怪再后方。女主座位外侧留有起身避让的空间。

【30秒严格分镜】

镜头1｜0—3秒
桌面高度主全景，缓慢推进。
雨夜茶馆，茶客喝茶聊天。
男主用竹勺舀起一块完整豆花，在小碟蘸水中轻轻一蘸，认真送进嘴里。
女主坐右侧喝茶。
四位怪客已经走到桌边，龙虾怪俯身盯着豆花。
画面后方能看见两把并排空竹椅。

镜头2｜3—5秒
硬切，豆花碗侧上方近景。
男主将竹勺暂放碗沿。
龙虾怪把一只大钳伸入碗内，钳尖试图夹起柔软豆花。
钳子一合，豆花从缝隙滑落；再夹一次，又被切碎。
它急躁地拨动钳尖，豆花在清汤里碎成小块。
碗只轻晃，汤不泼出。

镜头3｜5—8秒
硬切，女主近景，龙虾怪钳子在画面边缘继续笨拙拨动。
女主低头看碗，再抬眼看它，用自然重庆话说：
“你吃豆花，还是和水泥哦？”

男主在背景慢慢停住咀嚼，视线落到碎豆花上。

硬切，桌边平视中景。

男主身体不后退，抬左手托住扫来的钳臂下缘，同时右手扣住它刚落在桌沿的另一只钳臂。
双手均抓在厚实外壳上，远离钳口。

镜头5｜10—12秒
硬切，男主与龙虾怪的半身侧景。

龙虾怪向后抽身，脚底在石板上短擦一下，却抽不出钳臂。

女主起身侧让，左手挡开他的手腕，右掌短促拍在他脸侧。

法老顺着掌力转过半身，头冠歪斜，撞到身后怪嘴怪胸前。
怪嘴怪将他扶住，两者退离女主。
女主收手，稳稳站在自己椅子旁，没有踢腿或追击。

镜头7｜15—18秒
硬切回男主侧面的中广景。
机械绅士先挥普通拳打向男主腹部。
拳头接触皮衣，男主不动，机械绅士反而缩手甩两下。
它马上换机械手，伸进两只交叉钳臂之间，试图撬开。
龙虾怪同时挣扎，钳臂外壳向内一合，把机械绅士的金属手套卡住。

机械绅士抽手，发现卡住，立刻用另一只手抓住龙虾怪肩甲，避免自己失去平衡。
只有金属手套被夹，没有肉手受伤。

镜头8｜18—21秒
硬切，过道侧向全景，完整展示四怪与男主之间的连接。
法老抓住机械绅士腰后的衣料，向后拉。
怪嘴怪站在法老身后，双手抓住法老腰带，再往后拉。
形成清楚的一串：
男主控制龙虾怪双钳；
机械绅士的机械手卡在双钳之间；
法老拉机械绅士；
怪嘴怪拉法老。
后方两把空竹椅就在这一串人的退路上。

四怪一起向后使劲，膝盖弯曲、身体后仰。
男主双脚站稳，手臂只轻微绷紧。
配乐跟随四次使劲，发出短促节拍。

同一侧向全景，不切掉关键动作。
男主看一眼四怪已经后仰的姿态，突然松开双钳，同时在龙虾怪胸甲上补一记短促平推。
失去前方阻力，四怪沿原本拉扯方向一同向后踉跄。

最后方怪嘴怪的腿先碰到竹椅，坐了下去；
法老被带得转坐进旁边竹椅；
机械绅士后退撞上法老膝前，滑坐到石板上；
龙虾怪被卡住的机械手牵住，最后一屁股坐在机械绅士旁边。

四怪挤成狼狈一团，竹椅受力“嘎吱”，但不碎裂。
龙虾怪放松钳臂，机械绅士这才把手抽出来，赶紧抱在胸前。
不出现四人整齐飞起，不穿过桌椅，不撞热水。

镜头10｜24—27秒
硬切，桌边男女主中景。
男主拉回椅子坐下，女主也重新坐回右侧。
她俯身看一眼那碗已经碎成汤的豆花，再看男主，用重庆话问：
“现在咋个吃？”

男主盯着碗，停半拍。
背景四怪仍在竹椅旁整理彼此的手脚，不再次冲来。

镜头11｜27—30秒
硬切，男主正面近景，画面下缘包括豆花碗。
男主先将竹勺从碗沿取下放在桌面，双手端起粗瓷碗，喝一大口稀碎豆花汤。
放低碗，抬眼，用低沉、一本正经的重庆话说：

女主先看他，再看碗，忍住笑，端起自己的盖碗。
背景传来机械绅士活动手腕的轻微“吱嘎”声。
口哨配乐轻巧收尾，硬切结束。

仅三句清晰对白，全部自然重庆口音，口型同步：
女主：“你吃豆花，还是和水泥哦？”
女主：“现在咋个吃？”
男主：“豆浆。省得嚼。”

女主吐槽轻巧，不大喊；男主低沉平静，最后一句带认真解决问题的满足感。
怪客只有含混哼声与受挫喘气，不增加台词。

雨声、盖碗声、竹勺碰瓷声、钳尖轻碰碗内壁声。
夸张1970年代拟音：拍桌闷响、清脆掌声、金属卡扣、石板擦步、竹椅嘎吱、落座闷响。

始终只有四位怪客，各自外形不混合、不复制。

机械绅士的手明确先伸进双钳间，再被卡住，最后随着钳臂放松抽出。
法老与怪嘴怪先抓稳前人，再向后拉，不能凭空连成一串。

男主长剑不出鞘，不使用激光、魔法或发光特效。

作品名称：《滥竽充数：全员露馅》

历史背景：战国时期，齐国宫廷。
故事来源：《韩非子·内储说上》中的滥竽充数寓言，进行艺术改编。

一、视频身份

本片是一段由跨越时间的虚构监控系统记录下来的齐国宫廷乐堂监控档案。

这必须是一段能够直接辨认监控身份的影像。

古人不知道监控系统存在，也不会与摄像头互动。

CAM 01安装于乐堂西南侧屋顶横梁下方。

采用固定广角监控镜头，同时覆盖乐师表演区域、传令官入口和东侧出口。

整个视频保持完全一致的摄像头位置、广角透视、建筑结构、地平线和空间关系。

不得出现跟拍、推轨、摇臂、环绕、电影特写或无来源切镜。

三、监控成像制式

选择C6高规格数字彩色监控。

16:9画面，自然克制的真实彩色。

建筑纹理清晰，人物可辨，适度数字锐化，轻微视频压缩痕迹，边缘轻微软化，合理曝光及极轻微传感器噪声。

整体呈现高质量现代数字监控设备观察古代现场的真实成像效果。

不能生成电影摄影机特有的夸张浅景深、浓重胶片颗粒或过度电影化镜头质感。

四、监控档案界面

最终画面必须持续存在稳定、清晰的监控标识。

右上角：
PLAY

左下角：
ARCHIVE 017

右下角：
从00:00:00连续递增至约00:00:15的录像相对时间码。

界面使用小型、锐利、清晰、具有真实监控播放器特征的文字。

标识位置稳定，不遮挡关键人物行动。

五、电影级固定监控构图

下午阳光从画面左侧自然照入，形成真实长阴影及极轻微的空气浮尘。

视觉变化全部通过人物运动产生，摄像机始终不动。

环境符合战国齐国的合理艺术重构。

采用木构建筑、深色漆饰、朴素而具有身份差异的古代衣料、合理束发及青铜装饰。

中年男性，赭褐色长袍，神态略显心虚，手持古代多管竽。

古代竽的簧管音乐在巨大乐堂中回响。

说完抱紧自己的竽，迅速朝右侧出口走去。

旁边另一名乐师立即跟上。

接着又有一人跟上。

其余假乐师也开始一个接一个起身离开。

动作形成逐渐加速的多米诺骨牌式喜剧效果。

七名乐师沿合理路线向同一侧门离开，不能相互穿模或瞬移。

摄像头不跟随他们。

原本整齐的乐队只剩下一位真正的年轻乐师。

空荡荡的乐堂产生强烈视觉反差。

剧情第四阶段：真正的独奏

最后的年轻乐师独自坐在巨大的宫廷乐堂中。

他看了看陆续离开的人群，随后平静地举起自己的竽。

吹出一个清晰、稳定、悠长的簧管音符。

声音在宽阔的乐堂内自然回响。

传令官目瞪口呆，望着唯一留下的年轻人，忍不住问：

年轻乐师依然保持持竽姿态。

固定监控镜头保持不动。

以现场巨大的空旷空间和尴尬的沉默自然结束。

不再增加额外反转或无关动作。

八、声音设计

全片使用自然普通话，确保口型、人物与对白同步。

开头为真实的古代簧管合奏音色。

传令官宣布命令时，声音具有符合距离的建筑混响。

最后只剩一个清晰的竽音。

传令官的最后一句对白应当带有克制的惊愕。

不添加旁白、罐头笑声、人工观众鼓掌或不必要的电影配乐。

九、动作与时间连续性

15秒内保持连续真实时间。

开头八名乐师，最终七人离开，只剩一人。

每个人的竽必须始终与其持有者对应。

不存在凭空出现、消失、复制的人物或道具。

传令官始终处于同一建筑空间。

右侧出口位置固定。

摄像头安装位置、彩色成像制式、广角透视、监控画质、档案界面与录像时间码始终一致。

十、最终导演要求

让喜剧来自真实的宫廷命令、人物心虚、逐渐扩大的跟风逃离、原本整齐的队形突然瓦解，以及真正乐师独自演奏带来的荒诞反差。

全片同时具有明确的监控记录感和专业电影美学。

一切戏剧张力都存在于固定监控画面内部。

必须生成Seedance 2.0完整15秒的视频。

FORMAT
Exactly 24 seconds, vertical 9:16, one continuous uninterrupted take, no cuts. Authentic found footage: a real prank filmed at night in 2004 on a cheap consumer MiniDV handycam. Fast, punchy pacing with no dead pauses. It must look like a genuine home recording, not a film and not a modern phone video.

CAMCORDER IMAGE (MANDATORY)
Standard-definition MiniDV look, about 480 lines upscaled: soft image, interlacing combing on fast motion, mild sharpening halos, low dynamic range, ceiling lights and steel reflections blown to white, shadows crushed to black with chroma noise, warm yellow white balance, slow auto-exposure and autofocus. No HDR, no smartphone sharpness, no cinematic grading, no shallow depth of field. People, skin, fabric, steel, and concrete look physically genuine through this imperfect image. No REC text, date stamp, or any overlay.

HANDHELD OPERATION
Held by an unseen friend. Natural hand shake that grows with emotion: sway while hiding, bouncing while laughing, violent jolts during the fall, trembling at the reveal. Tilted horizon, framing that drifts and corrects late, focus that hunts before locking, clumsy zooms that overshoot, heads sometimes cut off by the frame edge. The operator, his hands, body, shadow, reflection, and the camcorder NEVER appear on screen, including in steel doors and walls. Only his voice is heard, close to the mic.

LOCATION
Old apartment building corridor at night, 2004: yellowed beige walls with scuffs, worn grey tile floor, warm ceiling lights, one fluorescent tube flickering down the hall. Brushed steel elevator landing doors with a steel sill. On the wall right of the doors: a call button and, taped above it, a white A4 sheet with large bold black letters "OUT OF ORDER". Above the doors: a small red digital display showing "7". Cabin interior: scratched brushed steel walls, cold white ceiling light, rear handrail, button panel on the right front wall.

CHARACTERS
OPERATOR: never seen, voice only, young man, excited whisper, loud laugh.
FRIEND B: man, about 24, blond curly hair, denim jacket, white T-shirt, grey jeans, a silver flip phone in his right front pocket.
JAKE: man, about 25, short dark hair, light grey hoodie, black backpack on one shoulder, white sneakers, wired earbuds, texting on an open silver flip phone.
Ordinary real-looking people, natural skin with imperfections, consistent faces and clothing throughout.

THE PRINT
A thin vinyl sticker cut to exactly the size of the cabin floor, wall to wall, no white border, nothing extending into the corridor. It shows a photo of a shaft looking down and from a distance convincingly looks like a missing floor. Up close, gloss and faint creases reveal it is flat. The image stays identical whenever visible.

THE REAL SHAFT
Seen only at the end: irregular and physically real, rough stained concrete, a steel guide rail with rusty brackets, snapped greasy cables, dust. Never symmetrical, never a repeating tunnel, no visible bottom, no lit end. Completely unlike the print.

TIMELINE
0.0-2.5 seconds:
Shaky shot straight into the open elevator: the floor seems missing, a deep shaft below. The operator giggles. Friend B steps into frame, plants one foot on the "void", the vinyl crinkles, he bounces once and grins at the lens: "Looks real, right?" He steps back out into the corridor.

2.5-4.5 seconds:
The camera whips to the wall right of the doors; focus locks on the "OUT OF ORDER" sheet. Friend B rips it off, crumples it, and stuffs it into his right front pocket: "Can't have that ruining it." He presses the call button to hold the doors open, and both flatten against the wall left of the doors. The camera settles beside the doorway, aimed into the cabin.

4.5-8.0 seconds:
Jake walks in from the right, texting on his flip phone, and steps into the cabin. His foot lands on the printed shaft: he screams "WHOA!", stumbles back two steps, and slams his back and backpack into the rear wall, grabbing the handrail. On that impact the whole cabin drops about ten centimeters with a heavy metallic CLUNK and tilts slightly, leaving a clear visible step between the cabin floor and the corridor sill. The cabin light flickers. Jake freezes, wide-eyed. No frozen T-pose, no arms held out straight.

8.0-11.0 seconds:
The operator bursts out laughing, thinking the clunk was part of the joke; the camera bounces. Friend B points into the cabin: "Bro, your face!" A clumsy zoom on Jake overshoots and cuts off his head. Jake sees it is a sticker, goes red, and slaps a button: "You guys are idiots." The doors slide closed and meet fully. The display still shows "7".

11.0-12.0 seconds:
Only after the doors are fully closed, the display changes to "6" with a motor hum. Friend B mimics Jake's scream.

12.0-15.0 seconds:
A massive metallic BANG behind the doors; the doors shudder in their frame. A sharp crack of a snapping cable, then the whip of loose cable. The display goes black. Instantly a piercing continuous steel-on-steel SCREECH: the cabin's emergency brakes grinding on the guide rails as it falls. It starts harsh right behind the doors, making them vibrate, then travels rapidly downward, more muffled, lower in pitch, hollow and echoing, with irregular knocks of the cabin hitting brackets. The corridor lights dip. The camera is thrown toward the tile, the mic clipping, then swings back to the doors, out of focus.

15.0-16.5 seconds:
The screech ends far below in a deep heavy CRASH; the floor shudders. A short echo rolls up the shaft, then silence except the fluorescent buzz and shaky breathing. Focus finds Friend B's face, half cut off by the frame, pale. Operator whispers: "Dude..."

16.5-18.5 seconds:
Friend B jams his fingers into the door seam and drags the doors apart with his whole body, sneakers slipping on tile. They grind open to shoulder width. Behind them: pure black.

18.5-20.5 seconds:
A click: the camcorder's small built-in light switches on, a harsh cold beam with fast falloff. The camera pushes to the gap over Friend B's shoulder. No cabin. The beam shows only the nearest few meters: stained concrete, a rusty bracket, snapped cables swaying and knocking the wall, dust in the beam, grit sprinkling onto the lens. The camera tilts down: the light dies after two floors, below is total black.

20.5-24.0 seconds:
Friend B pulls his flip phone from his right front pocket; the crumpled sign comes out with it, drops onto the tile beside the sill, and half unfolds. The camera tilts down and focus locks on the bold words "OUT OF ORDER". Above frame, Friend B flips the phone open, dials, and whispers: "...Jake?" A beat. From deep in the black shaft, faint and echoing, a silly polyphonic cartoon quacking ringtone starts playing. The camera stays on the sign at the edge of the shaft, trembling. The ringtone keeps playing. Take ends. No title, no further event.

PHYSICS AND REALISM
Real weight and inertia: Jake's stumble and backpack impact, the cabin's sudden ten-centimeter sag and tilt, laughter shaking the camera, finger strain and heavy door resistance, sneaker slip. Crumpled paper falls and unfolds naturally. Cables sway with decaying momentum; dust and grit fall with gravity. Light comes only from corridor practicals, the cabin light while the cabin is present, the camcorder light, and the phone screen.

AUDIO AND DIALOGUE
Camcorder onboard mic: close, thin, compressed, handling rustle, faint tape hiss, clipping on loud sounds. Vinyl crinkle, paper ripping and crumpling, whispers, footsteps, scream, backpack on steel, the cabin clunk, echoing laughter, button click, door motor, lift hum, the bang, cable snap and whip, the long brake screech traveling down with echo and knocks, the deep crash, fluorescent buzz, doors grinding, hollow shaft air, creaking cables, grit on the lens, and the distant echoing ringtone. The ringtone is an original simple quack melody, not any existing song. English dialogue only, naturally lip-synced: "Looks real, right?" / "Can't have that ruining it." / "WHOA!" / "Bro, your face!" / "You guys are idiots." / "Dude..." / "...Jake?" No music, narration, subtitles, or laugh track.

STRICT CONTINUITY
Two visible people plus the unseen operator. Jake is never seen after the doors close. The sticker stays in the cabin and leaves with it. The sign is torn off once, stays in the pocket, and falls out only at the end. The display changes only after the doors fully close and stays black after failing. One sag, one fall, one door opening. The cabin never returns. The real shaft never resembles the print. Nobody steps into the shaft. No smartphones, only flip phones. No blood, no bodies, no injuries, no visible sparks, no explosions, no extra people, no duplicated limbs. The operator and camcorder never appear in reflections or shadows.

手持操作
由一位未出镜的朋友手持。随情绪加重的自然手抖：躲藏时摇晃，发笑时上下跳动，坠落时剧烈颠簸，揭示时颤抖。地平线倾斜，取景漂移后迟迟才修正，对焦先来回搜寻再锁定，笨拙的变焦会过冲，人物头部有时被画框边缘切掉。拍摄者本人、他的双手、身体、影子、倒影和摄像机绝不入画，包括在钢制门和墙面中的反射里。只能听到他的声音，贴近麦克风。

场景
2004 年夜间老式公寓楼走廊：泛黄发旧的米色墙面带划痕，磨损的灰色瓷砖地面，暖色顶灯，走廊深处一根日光灯管在闪烁。拉丝不锈钢电梯层门，带不锈钢门槛。门右侧墙面上：一个呼叫按钮，按钮上方用胶带贴着一张白色 A4 纸，上面是粗体大号黑字 "OUT OF ORDER"。门上方：一个小型红色数码显示屏，显示 "7"。轿厢内部：划痕累累的拉丝钢墙面，冷白色顶灯，后部扶手，右前墙上的按钮面板。

朋友 B：男性，约 24 岁，金色卷发，牛仔夹克，白色 T 恤，灰色牛仔裤，右前口袋里装着一部银色翻盖手机。
杰克：男性，约 25 岁，深色短发，浅灰色连帽卫衣，黑色背包单肩背着，白色运动鞋，有线耳机，正用打开的银色翻盖手机发短信。
普通、真实感的人，肤质自然带瑕疵，全程面容与服装保持一致。

那张贴纸
一张薄乙烯基贴纸，裁切尺寸正好等于轿厢地面的大小，从墙到墙，没有白边，也没有任何部分延伸到走廊里。上面是一张竖井俯视的照片，远看足以让人信以为地板真的缺失了。近看时，光泽和细微折痕会暴露它其实是平的。每次出现在画面中，图案都完全相同。

真正的竖井
只在最后出现：形状不规则、物理真实，粗糙污渍的混凝土，一根钢制导轨配生锈的支架，断裂的沾着油污的缆绳，灰尘。绝不对称，绝不是重复的隧道，看不到底，也看不到被照亮的尽头。与贴纸上的图案完全不同。

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic sci-fi horror-thriller short film set inside a high-security underground biological research facility. The sequence begins with an immediate, violent hook at full speed. No slow motion until the designated moments. Maximum dynamic camera variety, grounded practical-effects filmmaking, realistic human reactions, and physical creature interaction. The horror must feel tangible, disturbing, and believable, like a premium theatrical sci-fi horror film.

SETTING
A massive underground research laboratory with reinforced glass chambers, steel walkways, industrial machinery, specimen containers, computer terminals, cables, and flickering fluorescent lights. Four scientists in protective laboratory clothing work around a sealed experimental chamber. A strange, dark, semi-transparent biological organism is suspended inside a cylindrical containment tank. Its surface shifts like living smoke trapped beneath liquid glass.
Natural diegetic sound and an intense suspense score begin immediately.
SEQUENCE — 30 SECONDS
[0–1s] — THE BREACH
Extreme close-up, real-time. A containment chamber's pressure gauge suddenly spikes into the red. The thick glass fractures with a violent explosive crack. Black translucent biological material bursts through the opening, spraying across nearby equipment. The camera jolts from the impact.
[1–2s] — SOMETHING ALIVE
Low-angle floor-level tracking shot racing alongside the spreading organism. The dark substance flows unnaturally against gravity, climbing a steel table leg while tendril-like structures snap outward at frightening speed. Electrical sparks flash in the background.
[2–3s] — FIRST CONTACT
Whip-pan to a scientist turning toward the noise. A thin black tendril shoots across the frame and wraps around his protective sleeve. His eyes widen. He attempts to pull away as the creature rapidly spreads across his arm.
[3–4s] — THE TAKEOVER
Overhead shot. The organism races across the scientist's body, forming a dark, translucent membrane over his protective clothing. He stumbles backward into a specimen table, knocking equipment onto the floor. Other scientists begin screaming and retreating.
[4–5s] — PRACTICAL HORROR
Extreme close-up of the scientist's gloved hand. The material pulses beneath the glove, the fabric stretches, and the fingers lock into a rigid, unnatural position. The creature pulls him violently out of frame. Avoid excessive graphic gore; emphasize physical transformation, sound, and terror.
[5–6s] — PANIC
Wide handheld shot pulling backward quickly. The remaining three scientists scatter through the laboratory. One knocks over a metal cart, another slams a security door, and the third grabs a portable industrial lamp. Red emergency lights activate.
[6–7s] — IT DIVIDES
Fast side-tracking shot. The organism splits into several narrow, rapidly moving tendrils that travel across the floor and up the walls. The camera follows one tendril as it disappears beneath a steel workstation.
[7–8s] — SECOND ATTACK
Low-angle shot from behind laboratory equipment. A tendril launches forward and catches a fleeing scientist around the ankle. He falls hard onto the floor, his ID badge skidding across the tiles. The camera shakes with the impact.
[8–9s] — THE SCREAM
Close-up of his face as the lights flicker. A dark membrane climbs toward his shoulder while he reaches desperately toward the others. The camera abruptly cuts away at the peak of his scream, leaving his fate unclear.
[9–10s] — RUN
Handheld chase-cam following the two remaining scientists sprinting through a narrow corridor between containment stations. Alarms blare. One glances over her shoulder as the organism crawls rapidly across the ceiling behind them.
[10–11s] — THE COUNTERMEASURE
Quick cut. The lead scientist tears open an emergency equipment cabinet and grabs a high-powered ultraviolet sterilization unit. Her hands shake as she activates it. The device emits a harsh electrical whine.
[11–12s] — FIRST STRIKE
Extreme close-up of the UV emitter igniting. She swings it toward the approaching organism and fires a concentrated ultraviolet beam. The beam illuminates the creature's translucent structure, revealing rapidly moving internal tendrils.
[12–13s] — SLOW MOTION INSERT
Slow motion reserved for this moment only. The organism recoils from the ultraviolet beam, its surface bubbling and contracting as its tendrils pull away from the light. Tiny particles burn away in the air. Make the practical effects tactile and realistic, not cartoonish.
[13–14s] — THE TRAP
Wide shot, real-time. The second surviving scientist rushes to a heavy industrial isolation gate and begins lowering it manually. The lead scientist maintains the UV beam while the creature surges toward them from multiple directions.
[14–15s] — SURROUNDING THREAT
Dynamic 360-degree tracking shot around the two scientists. The organism climbs the walls and stretches across the ceiling, attempting to bypass the gate. Their faces show exhaustion, fear, and intense concentration.
[15–16s] — A RISKY DECISION
Tight close-up on the lead scientist's face. She notices a pressurized cryogenic coolant line connected to the containment system. She looks at her partner and points toward it. A loud metallic impact comes from behind them.
[16–17s] — BREAKING THE LINE
Fast side-angle shot. The second scientist strikes the coolant valve with a heavy steel tool. The pipe ruptures, releasing a powerful cloud of freezing vapor across the corridor. Frost rapidly spreads over the nearby metal surfaces.
[17–18s] — THE CREATURE FREEZES
Overhead shot. The organism's tendrils stiffen as the freezing vapor surrounds it. Its movement becomes erratic and sluggish. The scientists retreat behind the partially lowered isolation gate.
[18–19s] — FINAL SURGE
Dynamic low-angle shot. The creature suddenly launches one last elongated tendril beneath the gate, scraping violently across the floor toward the lead scientist's boot. She stumbles backward as the UV unit flickers.
[19–20s] — SLOW MOTION CONTAINMENT
Slow motion reserved for this containment moment. The second scientist slams the emergency isolation switch. The reinforced gate drops with tremendous force, trapping the creature on the opposite side. Freezing vapor rolls through the frame as the tendril strikes the sealed barrier.
[20–21s] — SILENCE AFTER IMPACT
Real-time close-up. The lead scientist falls against the wall, breathing heavily. The UV unit sparks and shuts down. The heavy gate vibrates from a final impact.
[21–22s] — THE SURVIVORS
Wide shot. Both scientists stand several feet apart, shaken and covered in condensation. Emergency lights flicker across their faces. Neither speaks. Only heavy breathing and the distant alarm remain audible.
[22–24s] — THE SEALED CORRIDOR
Slow push-in, real-time. The laboratory is damaged: shattered glass, scattered instruments, drifting coolant vapor, and flickering monitors. Behind the isolation gate, the dark organism appears motionless.
[24–25s] — IT ISN'T DEAD
Extreme close-up through a small reinforced observation window. A tiny dark filament slowly moves across the frozen surface of the sealed chamber. A faint pulse travels through the organism.
[25–26s] — WARNING
Close-up of trembling hands as the lead scientist activates a manual containment lock. A red warning indicator illuminates on the control panel. Do not add readable text overlays or subtitles.
[26–28s] — RETREAT
Tracking shot from behind the two scientists as they move toward the emergency exit. They keep looking back at the containment gate. The camera slowly stabilizes as they increase their distance from the chamber.
[28–30s] — FINAL HORROR
Extreme close-up through the observation window.

创作一部 30 秒、极致写实的电影级科幻恐怖惊悚短片，场景设定在一座高度戒备的地下生物研究设施内。该片段以一开场就全速呈现的猛烈钩子切入。除指定时刻外，不得使用慢动作。追求最大化的动态镜头多样性、扎实的特效化妆（实拍特效）电影手法、真实的人类反应，以及与生物实体的实体互动。恐怖感必须是可触摸的、令人不安且可信的，如同高端院线科幻恐怖片。

场景
一座庞大的地下研究实验室，配有强化玻璃舱室、钢制走道、工业机械、标本容器、计算机终端、电缆，以及闪烁的荧光灯。四名身穿防护实验服的科学家在一间密封的实验舱周围工作。一团诡异、黑暗、半透明的生物体悬浮在圆柱形收容罐内。它的表面如被困在液态玻璃下的活体烟雾般不断变幻。
自然同期声与紧张的悬疑配乐即刻响起。
分镜 — 30 秒
[0–1 秒] — 破舱
极近特写，实拍速度。收容舱的压力表突然飙入红区。厚重玻璃伴随猛烈的爆裂声碎裂。黑色半透明的生物物质从裂口喷涌而出，溅洒到附近的设备上。镜头因冲击而猛然晃动。
[1–2 秒] — 活物
地面高度低角度跟拍镜头，与蔓延的生物体并行疾速移动。深色物质违背重力流动，沿着钢制桌腿向上攀爬，同时触手状结构以骇人的速度向外弹射。背景中电火花闪烁。
[2–3 秒] — 首次接触
甩镜（whip-pan）至一名转身朝向声响的科学家。一条细长的黑色触手横穿画面，缠住他的防护袖。他的双眼瞪大。他试图挣脱，而生物体正迅速蔓延至他的手臂。
[3–4 秒] — 侵占
俯拍镜头。生物体在科学家身上飞速扩散，在其防护服上形成一层深色半透明的膜。他踉跄后退撞上标本台，将器械掀落在地。其他科学家开始尖叫并后退逃离。
[4–5 秒] — 特效恐怖
科学家戴手套的手部极近特写。物质在手套下搏动，织物被拉伸，手指锁定成僵硬、不自然的位置。生物体将他猛然拽出画面。避免过度血腥的直观画面；强调物理形变、声音与恐惧感。
[5–6 秒] — 恐慌
广角手持镜头快速后拉。其余三名科学家在实验室中四散奔逃。一人撞翻金属推车，另一人砰地关上安全门，第三人抓起一盏便携式工业灯。红色应急灯亮起。
[6–7 秒] — 分裂
快速的侧向跟拍镜头。生物体分裂成数条细长、急速移动的触手，贴着地面并爬上墙壁。镜头跟随其中一条触手，拍摄它消失到一台钢制工作台下方。
[7–8 秒] — 第二次袭击
从实验室设备后方拍摄的低角度镜头。一条触手猛然弹出，缠住一名逃跑科学家的脚踝。他重重摔倒在地上，胸牌在瓷砖上滑出。镜头因撞击而晃动。
[8–9 秒] — 尖叫
灯光闪烁中他的面部特写。一层深色薄膜向他的肩膀攀升，他绝望地朝其他人伸手。镜头在他尖叫的最顶点突然切走，留下他的命运不明。
[9–10 秒] — 奔跑
手持追拍镜头，跟随剩下的两名科学家在收容站之间的狭窄走廊中飞奔。警报声刺耳响起。其中一人回头瞥了一眼，只见生物体正沿着他们身后的天花板快速爬行。
[10–11 秒] — 反制手段
快速剪辑。领队科学家猛地拉开应急设备柜，抓出一台高功率紫外线灭菌装置。她双手颤抖地启动它。装置发出刺耳的电鸣声。
[11–12 秒] — 首次攻击
紫外线发射器点火的极近特写。她将装置甩向逼近的生物体，发射出一道集中的紫外线光束。光束照亮生物体半透明的结构，显露其中快速移动的内部触手。
[12–13 秒] — 慢动作插入
仅此一处保留慢动作。生物体从紫外线光束前退缩，表面冒泡收缩，触手从光线中抽离。细小的微粒在空气中被烧蚀消解。让特效呈现触感与真实感，不要卡通化。
[13–14 秒] — 陷阱
广角镜头，实拍速度。第二名幸存的科学家冲向一道厚重的工业隔离闸门，开始手动将其降下。领队科学家维持紫外线光束，同时生物体从多个方向朝他们猛扑过来。
[14–15 秒] — 包围的威胁
围绕两名科学家的动态 360 度环绕跟拍镜头。生物体爬上墙壁并横跨天花板，试图绕过闸门。他们的脸上写满疲惫、恐惧与极度专注。
[15–16 秒] — 冒险的抉择
领队科学家面部的紧凑特写。她注意到一条与收容系统相连的加压低温冷却管路。她看向搭档并指向它。他们身后传来一声响亮的金属撞击声。
[16–17 秒] — 破管
快速侧角镜头。第二名科学家用沉重的钢制工具砸击冷却阀。管道爆裂，一股强大的冰冷雾气释放出来，横扫走廊。霜迅速蔓延到附近的金属表面。
[17–18 秒] — 生物体冻结
俯拍镜头。冰冷雾气包围生物体，其触手变得僵硬。它的动作变得紊乱而迟缓。科学家们退到部分降下的隔离闸门后方。
[18–19 秒] — 最后的猛扑
动态低角度镜头。生物体突然从闸门下方射出最后一条细长触手，贴着地面刮擦前进，直逼领队科学家的靴子。她踉跄后退，紫外线装置开始闪烁。
[19–20 秒] — 慢动作收容
仅此收容时刻保留慢动作。第二名科学家猛砸紧急隔离开关。强化闸门以巨大的力量落下，将生物体困在另一侧。冰冷雾气在画面中翻滚，触手撞击在密封屏障上。
[20–21 秒] — 撞击后的寂静
实拍速度特写。领队科学家靠在墙上，大口喘息。紫外线装置迸出火花后停止工作。沉重的闸门因最后一次冲击而震动。
[21–22 秒] — 幸存者
广角镜头。两名科学家相隔数英尺站立，浑身湿透、惊魂未定。应急灯在他们脸上闪烁。没有人说话。只有沉重的呼吸声与远处的警报声可闻。
[22–24 秒] — 封闭的走廊
缓慢推入，实拍速度。实验室一片狼藉：碎裂的玻璃、散落的器械、飘荡的冷却雾气，以及闪烁的监视器。隔离闸门后方，那团深色生物体似乎静止不动。
[24–25 秒] — 它没死
透过小型强化观察窗的极近特写。一条细小的深色丝状体在封闭舱室的冰冻表面上缓缓移动。生物体内部传来一阵微弱的脉动。
[25–26 秒] — 警告
颤抖的手部特写，领队科学家启动手动收容锁。控制面板上的红色警告指示灯亮起。不要添加可读的文本叠加或字幕。
[26–28 秒] — 撤离
从两名科学家背后拍摄的跟拍镜头，他们朝紧急出口移动。他们不断回头望向收容闸门。随着他们与舱室的距离拉大，镜头逐渐稳定下来。
[28–30 秒] — 最终恐怖
透过观察窗的极近特写。

2. 完整故事
宗门清晨点卯。

小师妹答应帮暂时不在场的师姐应一声。

为了避免露馅，她偷偷在师姐空着的位置放了一枚能够模仿师姐声音的白玉传声符。

这枚传声符事先留存了两句声音：
第一句：
“弟子在。”
第二句：
“领命。”

小师妹原本只打算使用第一句。

但精明的师父早已发现她的小动作，却故意装作不知道。

随后，师父安排师姐今夜负责打扫山门。

小师妹一紧张，竟然误触了第二句。

传声符当众响亮地回答：

“领命！”

恰好，真正的师姐此时回来了。

她听见自己的声音接受任务，又看见小师妹藏着的传声符，立即明白发生了什么。

她没有揭穿小师妹，也没有生气。

而是笑着把一把扫帚交给小师妹。

原本帮忙点卯的小师妹，莫名其妙成了今晚替师姐打扫山门的人。
